subject: Evaluation acceptance checklist, stop-loss thresholds & test inventory
messages:
From: Imran Shah <imran.shah@healthgrid.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 16:10:00 +0000
Subject: Eval: acceptance criteria & timeline (initial)

Lukas — thanks again for the demo today. We wanted to capture what success looks like for our 4-week evaluation so we can move quickly toward procurement. High level asks from HealthGrid:

- Verified latency and error budgets for our production-like workload (p95, p99).
- Proof that inference runs within our VPC and that logs can be exported for audit.
- A simple acceptance test suite we can run end-to-end on our sample dataset.

Can you propose an acceptance checklist and any hard stop/kill-switch thresholds you recommend? We also need a mutual action plan (MAP) so both teams know sign-offs and the close timeline.

—Imran
Dr. Imran Shah
Head of ML Ops, HealthGrid

(HealthGrid evaluation admin copied)
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Imran Shah <imran.shah@healthgrid.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 17:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Eval: acceptance criteria & timeline (draft MAP + stop-loss)

Imran — appreciate the clear asks. I've sketched a short MAP and an "acceptance + stop-loss" checklist below; attaching the spreadsheet with owners and the acceptance-tests.md that maps each test to telemetry we will collect.

Summary (4-week eval):
- Week 0 (kickoff): share artifacts + access (VPC peering details, sample dataset, test harness).
- Week 1 (baseline): run smoke tests against small dataset; validate p95/p99 on 1k requests.
- Week 2 (scale): run production-like runs (10k requests/day), validate autoscaling and KV cache behavior.
- Week 3 (hardening): run regression & integration tests; security checklist (KMS access, audit trail).
- Week 4 (decision): joint review meeting, acceptance sign-off or close with pre-agreed fallbacks.

Acceptance criteria (proposed):
- Latency: p95 <= 280 ms, p99 <= 650 ms (for full model pipeline on HealthGrid test trace).
- Accuracy: task-specific metric >= agreed baseline (we'll map to recall/precision thresholds in acceptance-tests.md).
- Errors: end-to-end error rate < 0.5% across the run.
- Reliability: no sustained degradation for > 15 minutes; any incident that breaches SLOs must be reproducible and documented.

Stop-loss (our term for the 'kill switch'):
- Stop-loss triggers immediate rollback to a fallback variant and pauses the trial if any of the following happen:
  * p95 latency > 600 ms for > 10 minutes, OR
  * error rate > 2% for > 5 minutes, OR
  * data exfiltration concern flagged by audit tooling.

Acceptance tests (examples):
- End-to-end smoke (1k sample requests): pass/fail + latency histograms.
- Regression set (500 golden examples): task metric delta <= -2% from baseline.
- Latency percentiles under synthetic load (load generator config in smoke-scripts.zip).
- Audit/log export: confirm logs/trace delivered to HealthGrid S3 with correct retention.

Next steps: Marissa will own the test inventory, Soojin will own rollout gating and stop-loss wiring, Ben will own the instrumentation dashboard we share. Imran — can you confirm the sample dataset and a preferred kickoff time next week?

Thanks,
Lukas Meyer
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Imran Shah <imran.shah@healthgrid.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Eval: acceptance criteria & timeline (draft MAP + stop-loss)

All — quick edits to the draft acceptance-tests.md (attached):

1) For the regression set, let's agree on a stratified sample: 60% standard cases / 40% edge cases. We'll include an easy-to-run script and expected outputs.
2) Add a privacy smoke test: synthetic PII redaction check (log-level verification only). HealthGrid requires that logs do not include raw PII — we will provide the redaction config.
3) Document the manual sign-off: Product manager at HealthGrid + Redwood Solutions lead (Lukas or Marissa) must both sign acceptance to move to procurement.

I'll update MAP-stoploss-v1.xlsx with these owners and a per-day checklist so the customer can tick off items during the run.

- Marissa
Sr. Manager, Solutions Ops — Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Imran Shah <imran.shah@healthgrid.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 14:35:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Eval: acceptance criteria & timeline (draft MAP + stop-loss)

Adding rollout gating details (so this is explicit and reproducible):

- Canary window: 30 minutes at 10% traffic, observe metrics (latency p95/p99, error rate, memory pressure).
- Canary decision rule: if any key metric breaches the stop-loss thresholds during the canary, we abort and roll back immediately.
- Telemetry: we will provide a Grafana link and a downloadable CSV of raw samples after each run. For audit, HealthGrid will get a daily export to their secure S3 bucket.

Implementation notes:
- We will wire a webhook that triggers the abort workflow; HealthGrid retains final authority to flip the switch.
- Ben: can you ensure the smoke-scripts include a deterministic workload generator so HealthGrid can re-run locally?

Soojin
Principal Reliability Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Imran Shah <imran.shah@healthgrid.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 18:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Eval: acceptance criteria & timeline (final MAP + kickoff)

Imran — thanks for the quick review and the confirmation in-thread earlier today. Per our agreement, attached is the finalized MAP spreadsheet and the acceptance-tests.md that maps each acceptance criterion to a specific test, owner, and evidence artifact. Quick summary of the final, agreed items:

- Acceptance thresholds: p95 <= 280ms, error rate < 0.5%, task metric delta <= -2% from HealthGrid baseline.
- Stop-loss triggers: p95 > 600ms for >10m, error rate > 2% for >5m, or any audit/PII concern. Triggering stop-loss pauses the trial and reverts to the fallback variant.
- Rollout gating: 30-min canary at 10% with webhook-driven abort.
- Sign-off: HealthGrid PM + Redwood Solutions lead (Marissa) must both confirm before procurement.

Proposed kickoff: Wednesday 7/1 at 11:00 AM ET — we'll run Week 1 smoke tests the same day. Please reply with a thumbs-up if the time works or propose an alternate.

Looking forward to getting this moving. We'll keep the MAP worksheet writable for both teams during the run.

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-stoploss-v1.xlsx (owners checklist), acceptance-tests.md (test definitions), smoke-scripts.zip (workload generators)
